expected_chain_progression.pass_gate: chain must progress; statistical stale gate and continuous liveness/coverage remain authoritative rather than an artificial exact block-count quota

reorg.semantics: Every observed reorg must be retained and admitted in final evidence. This contract does not invent a zero-reorg PASS threshold absent from the V2 frozen PASS criteria.

terminal_classifications.PASS: Only a complete >=96h run with every frozen scientific and evidence gate true.
terminal_classifications.FAIL: Complete, evidence-sufficient run that falsifies one or more scientific/liveness gates.
terminal_classifications.INCONCLUSIVE: Interrupted or otherwise non-terminal run without evidence proving provider or harness causality.
terminal_classifications.PROVIDER_FAILURE: Provider causality must be positively proven; absence of evidence is insufficient.
terminal_classifications.HARNESS_FAILURE: Harness/control-plane causality must be positively proven; absence of evidence is insufficient.
terminal_classifications.EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE: Required evidence is missing, malformed, coverage-incomplete, revision-drifted, or non-admissible.
